# NFTViewer

> Multi-chain NFT gallery browser. Lightweight, private, no wallet connection required. Part of the GEMBA IT ecosystem.

NFTViewer lets anyone browse a wallet's NFT collection across five EVM networks. Paste a wallet address, pick a chain, and the gallery loads with metadata, images, and a full-screen lightbox. There is no signup, no wallet connect, no tracking — just a fast read-only viewer.

## URLs

- Home: https://nftviewer.gembait.com/

## Quick facts

- Supported chains: Ethereum, Polygon, Base, BSC, Arbitrum
- Data source: Moralis API, proxied by a server-side backend (no user API key required)
- Privacy: no wallet connection, no account, no tracking
- Features: multi-chain search, filter to NFTs with images, full metadata lightbox, pagination
- Fallback: when indexers are missing data for freshly minted collections, the backend reads tokenURI directly and enriches metadata on the fly
- Animated legacy NFTs: a dedicated HTML proxy renders older collections inside the gallery

## How it works

1. Enter any wallet or contract address
2. Select the chain (Ethereum, Polygon, Base, BSC, Arbitrum)
3. The backend queries Moralis, enriches missing metadata by reading tokenURI on-chain where needed
4. Results render as a paginated grid; click any NFT for the lightbox view with metadata

## Technology

- Frontend: React, Vite
- Backend: Node.js / Express server-side proxy for Moralis requests
- Moralis API for indexed NFT data
- Direct RPC fallback (ethers.js) when indexers lag
